news.title: Capricorn Systems Global Solutions Limited (BSE:512169) agreed to acquire Radical Bio-Organics Limited.
news.body:
Capricorn Systems Global Solutions Limited (BSE:512169) agreed to acquire Radical Bio-Organics Limited on April 11, 2026. The share exchange ratio for the amalgamation of the Capricorn Systems Global with the Radical Bio-Organics Limited shall be 1 fully paid-up equity share of Capricorn Systems Global for every 1 fully paid-up equity share of Radical Bio-Organics Limited.

For the period ending February 28, 2026, Radical Bio-Organics Limited reported total revenue of INR 4.52 billion. As of February 28, 2026, Radical Bio-Organics Limited reported total assets of INR 2.26 billion and total common equity of INR 717.99 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by Capricorn Systems Global Solutions board. The deal has been approved by the board.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Over 6x increase in shares outstanding. This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.07 (vs ₹0.14 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.07 (up from ₹0.14 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹120.1m (up ₹117.5m from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹279.6k (up ₹820.8k from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.2% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 59% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 7% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
